question: airports within Greece
sql: SELECT a.name, a.iata_code FROM airports a JOIN countries c ON ST_Within(a.geometry, c.geometry) WHERE c.name = 'Greece' ORDER BY a.name, a.iata_code;

question: countries intersecting bbox 20 35 30 42
sql: SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3 FROM countries c WHERE ST_Intersects(c.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(20, 35, 30, 42)) ORDER BY c.name;

question: country containing BRU airport
sql: SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3 FROM countries c JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(c.geometry, a.geometry) WHERE a.iata_code = 'BRU' ORDER BY c.name;

question: airports in countries touching Greece
sql: SELECT a.name, a.iata_code FROM airports a JOIN countries c ON ST_Within(a.geometry, c.geometry) JOIN countries g ON ST_Touches(c.geometry, g.geometry) WHERE g.name = 'Greece' ORDER BY a.name, a.iata_code;

question: country containing point 22.9556 39.0747
sql: SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3 FROM countries c WHERE ST_Contains(c.geometry, ST_Point(22.9556, 39.0747)) ORDER BY c.name;

question: countries intersecting equator line 0 0 to 30 0
sql: SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3 FROM countries c WHERE ST_Intersects(c.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(0 0, 30 0)')) ORDER BY c.name;
